# Noah Jaffe

Official website of Noah Jaffe, a PhD researcher, musicologist, and
hardware/software engineer based in Amsterdam.

Primary topics:
- historical keyboard instruments
- harpsichord and fortepiano research
- PHOTON optical sensing platform
- computational musicology
- music information retrieval
- source separation
- embedded systems and performance capture
- concert production and Amsterdam early music

Key pages:
- https://noahjaffe.org/ — profile and overview
- https://noahjaffe.org/cv/ — CV, experience, education, and technical focus
- https://noahjaffe.org/publications/ — publications and works in progress
- https://noahjaffe.org/productions/ — concerts and production work

Important associated entities mentioned on the site:
- PHOTON — https://github.com/w4iei/PHOTON
- Music Cognition Group — https://www.mcg.uva.nl/
- Institute for Logic, Language and Computation — https://www.illc.uva.nl/
- University of Amsterdam — https://www.uva.nl/
- klavecimbel.com — https://klavecimbel.com
- AmsterdamEarlyMusic.com — https://amsterdamearlymusic.com
- Stichting Tijdloze Klavieren — https://amsterdamearlymusic.com
